name: 01886 · Westford, MA
findings: ZIP 01886 (Westford) has 108 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01886 (Westford) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 01886 (Westford) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).
